# Release notes

Thank you for using the product.

This update includes the sync improvements that many users have been asking for,
but it also contains a large number of internal changes,
so behaviour may differ in some environments,
so please check before you upgrade.

The purpose of this feature is so that work on several devices can continue without interruption.
The review of the settings of the new sync platform of our company makes it run faster than before.

Administrators can change the sync interval from the settings screen,
but for details please kindly refer to the documentation.

If you have any questions,
we would like to kindly ask that you please contact support.
Click here for the detailed steps.

First of all initially, note that this update is applied automatically,
so no action is required from the user;
users on the log-in page will be logged in again after approximately about ten minutes,
and the login page will then show the new version.
